sourceBinding: At execution require clean committed gameplay/build/harness, bind exact SOURCE_COMMIT to process record, and verify inventory hashes; this plan itself is not a native result.
scope: Parent-selected retained 52 namespaces plus three new Hall/wall namespaces; authored progression/sector seed/verify campaigns remain separate required gates.

generatorInventory.conclusion: No generated or dynamic test registrations found; count explicit annotated methods per holder, aggregating files sharing a namespace.

executionRules: Java 17 and Gradle 8.8; one writable native process at a time.
Use a new isolated controlled fixture for every single or seed phase. Never reset, delete or copy played/accepted worlds.
Seed and verify are separate JVMs with identical source, namespace, runtime manifests and world family; verify depends on successful reviewed seed.
Replace RUN_LABEL with a new safe lower-case label for the attempt; SOURCE_COMMIT is an exact 40-hex commit.
Run runGameTestServer with each -I initScripts entry and -P gradleProperties entry, through the native process recorder.

PASS requires exact expected completion count, exact required-pass count, zero native failures, exit code zero, unchanged committed source, and human log review. Never derive expected count from that same run output.
Retain logs and failed attempts; no EULA acceptance, deployed mods, live-world changes or owner acceptance implied.

runtimeProfiles.plain: Forge 47.4.10 / Minecraft 1.20.1, no external native weapon/vehicle dependency.

combined.selection: Keep pinned SimpleBedrockModel 2.6.2 from TaCZ; omit only duplicate top-level SBW 2.5.1, as checked by init scripts.
